context:
Mostly CI-file surgery plus one helper. w3 is the real verification --
a green run with gating on. If the run is red for an environmental
reason (runner disk, image pull), fix or scope that before merging; do
not re-add continue-on-error.
description:
The nightly throughput-uat job (.github/workflows/nightly.yml:550-624)
currently discards the entire sweep exit code via
`continue-on-error: true` (nightly.yml:596) because the TPC-H
Q11/16/18/20 seed-derivation defect kept the cell permanently red. With
that defect fixed (tpch-throughput-seed-validation-fix), everything
#1094 wired up -- the cell exit code, the validator_clean_rate_floor:
1.0, the strict report exit policy -- can start gating.

Also strengthen the one check that stayed hard: validate_stream_count
(tests/uat/throughput.py:96-106) counts a stream as "executed" if it has
at least one query row REGARDLESS of status -- a stream whose every
query failed still counts (verified on develop @ fc31f3604). Keep the
existing wiring-defect check (distinct stream ids == requested) and add
a second assertion that every counted stream has at least one
SUCCESSFUL query, so a total-failure stream cannot satisfy the gate.

Note the core success gates remain deliberately tolerant (TPC-H 0.99,
TPC-DS 0.70 per #1106) -- this TODO does not change them; it makes the
UAT layer actually consume the sweep verdict.
